model_annotation: This plot illustrates the step step missing for 0-CoT, Core, and a reference method, comparing their performance across a range of input values. The x-axis, labeled with integer values from 0 to 4, displays a linear scale with tick increments of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Step Step Missing,” ranges from approximately 0.843 to 0.860, utilizing a linear scale. The blue dashed line represents 0-CoT, beginning at a step step missing value of approximately 0.848 at x = 0 and decreasing linearly to approximately 0.832 at x = 1. The orange line represents Core, starting at a step step missing value of approximately 0.845 at x = 0 and gradually decreasing to approximately 0.838 at x = 3.  The red line, representing the reference method, starts at a step step missing value of approximately 0.843 at x = 0 and remains relatively constant at around 0.843 for the duration of the x-axis representation.
